import * as React from "react";
import Card from "@mui/material/Card";
import Container from "@mui/material/Container";
import CardActions from "@mui/material/CardActions";
import CardContent from "@mui/material/CardContent";
import CardMedia from "@mui/material/CardMedia";
import Button from "@mui/material/Button";
import Typography from "@mui/material/Typography";
import Grid from "@mui/material/Grid";
import project1 from "../../assets/project1.png";
import project2 from "../../assets/project2b.png";
export default function Project() {
    
  return (
    <Container
      style={{
        paddingTop: "2rem",
        paddingBottom: "2rem",
        marginTop: "2rem",
        marginBottom: "2rem",
        borderRadius: "10px",
        boxShadow: "0px 0px 10px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)",
      }}
    >
      <Typography variant="h2" sx={
        {
            fontWeight: "bold",
            fontSize: "3rem",
            color: "text",
            marginBottom: "1rem",
            marginTop: "1rem",
            textAlign: "center",
        }
      } >Project</Typography>
      <Grid justify=" center " container spacing={2}>
        <Grid item>
        <Card sx={{ 
                maxWidth: 350,
                marginTop: "1rem",
                marginBottom: "1rem",
                marginLeft: "auto",
                marginRight: "auto",
                boxShadow: "0px 0px 10px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)",
                borderRadius: "10px",
                display: "flex",
                flexDirection: "column",
                justifyContent: "center",
                alignItems: "center",
            }}>
            <CardMedia
              component="img"
              height="450"
              image={project1}
              alt="green iguana"
            />
            <CardContent>
              <Typography gutterBottom variant="h5" component="div">
                Bali Stuti
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                BaliStuti is a web application that helps you to find the best
                craftman products in Bali. Build with Laravel and Bootstrap.
              </Typography>
            </CardContent>
            <CardActions>
              <Button size="small">Visit</Button>
            </CardActions>
          </Card>
        </Grid>
        <Grid item xs={9} sm container>
          <Card sx={{ 
                maxWidth: 350,
                marginTop: "1rem",
                marginBottom: "1rem",
                marginLeft: "auto",
                marginRight: "auto",
                boxShadow: "0px 0px 10px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)",
                borderRadius: "10px",
                display: "flex",
                flexDirection: "column",
                justifyContent: "center",
                alignItems: "center",
            }}>
            <CardMedia
              component="img"
              height="450"
              image={project2}
              alt="green iguana"
            />
            <CardContent>
              <Typography gutterBottom variant="h5" component="div">
                Company profile
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                Bali travel guide responsive company profile website build with html, css and javascript.
              </Typography> 
            </CardContent>
            <CardActions>
              <Button size="small">Visit</Button>
            </CardActions>
          </Card>
        </Grid>
        <Grid item>
        <Card sx={{ 
                maxWidth: 350,
                marginTop: "1rem",
                marginBottom: "1rem",
                marginLeft: "auto",
                marginRight: "auto",
                boxShadow: "0px 0px 10px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)",
                borderRadius: "10px",
                display: "flex",
                flexDirection: "column",
                justifyContent: "center",
                alignItems: "center",
            }}>
            <CardMedia
              component="img"
              height="450"
              image={project1}
              alt="green iguana"
            />
            <CardContent>
              <Typography gutterBottom variant="h5" component="div">
                BaliStuti
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                BaliStuti is a web application that helps you to find the best
                craftman products in Bali. Build with html, css, javascript, bootstrap, and laravel.
              </Typography>
            </CardContent>
            <CardActions>
              <Button size="small">Visit</Button>
            </CardActions>
          </Card>
        </Grid>
      </Grid>
    </Container>
  );
}
